abstract.t: This document defines a JSON format for machine-readable Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure (CVD) policies. It also defines the proposed CVD-Policy field for discovery through security.txt and requests registration of the application/cvd-policy+json media type. The format complements security.txt and human-readable policy documents. A policy does not prove ownership and does not establish legal authorization to test, legal safe harbor, or the safety of an activity.
